texts.preamble: Da vs Sukhdev Sharma Etc. on 2 May, 2018 In The Court Of Samar Vishal, Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate - Ii Patiala House Courts, New Delhi Cc No. 40990/2016 Date of Institution : 14.01.2005 Date of reserving judgement : 02.05.2018 Date of pronouncement : 02.05.2018 In re: Delhi Administration / Food Inspector Department of Pfa, Govt. of Nct of Delhi A-20, Lawrence Road Industrial Area, Delhi-110035 ... Complainant versus A-1) Sh. Sukhdev Sharma s/o late Sh. Rikhi Ram Sharma M/s Punjab Pan House, 13, Prathvi Raj Mkt New Delhi-03 R/o D-200, Laxmi Nagar, Delhi-92 A-2) Smt. Laxmi w/o late Sh. Rikhi Ram Sharma, M/s Punjab Pan House, 13, Prathvi Raj Mkt New Delhi03 A-3) M/s Kothari Product Ltd. 24/ 19, The Mall, Kanpur 208001, Up. (India) A-4) Sri Rajesh Shah M/s Kothari Product Ltd., 24/ 19, The Mall, Kanpur 208001, Up. (India) ... Accused person Cc No. 40990/2016 Page No. 1/7 Da vs Sukhdev Sharma etc. Judgment: Da vs Sukhdev Sharma Etc. on 2 May, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100338657/ 1 1. The present is a complaint filed under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954
texts.facts: The present is a complaint filed under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (herein after referred to as PFA Act), alleging that the accused have violated the provisions of the PFA Act and Rules. 2. As per the complaint, on 20-07-2004 at about 4.30 pm, Food Inspector D.P. Singh purchased a sample of 'Pan Masala' (Pan Prag) a food article for analysis from accused No. 1 Sukhdev Sharma at M/s Punjab Pan House, 13, Prathvi Raj Mkt. New Delhi- 03 where the said food article was found stored for sale and where accused No. 1 Sukhdev Sharma was found conducting the business of the said food article at the time of sampling. The sample consisted of 9 X 100 gms sealed tins of "Pan Masala" taken as such in original sealed condition, having identical label declaration. The sample was taken under the supervision / direction of Sh. S.K. Hari, SDM/LHA. The Food Inspector divided the sample then and there into three equal parts, three sealed tins of sample were packed as one counter part. Each sample counter part was separately packed, fastened and sealed according to PFA Act & Rules. The vendor's signatures were obtained on the LHA slip and wrapper of the sample counter parts. Notice was given to accused No. 1 Sh. Sukhdev Sharma and the price of sample was also given vide vendor receipt dated 20-07- 2004. Panchnama too was prepared at the spot. All the documents prepared by F.I. were signed by accused No. 1 Sukhdev Sharma and the other witness Sh. Pratap Raj, FA. Before starting sample proceedings efforts were made to join public witnesses but none came forward, as such Sh. Pratap Raj, FA was joined as witness. DA vs Sukhdev Sharma etc. 3. One counter-part of the sample was also sent to Public Analyst, joint bearing LHA Code Number 31/LHA/6466 in intact condition and two counter--parts were deposited with the SDM/LHA in intact conditions. Public Analyst analysed the sample and found the sample to be non-conforming. The report of Public Analyst is as follows: "The sample does not conform to standard because Ash insoluble in dil HCl exceeds the prescribed maximum limit of 0.5%. Further it contains Magnesium Carbonate which is not allowed in Pan Masala (violation of Rule 62)." 4. It is the case of the complainant that accused No. 1 Sh. Sukhdev Sharma was the vendor of M/s Punjab Pan House, 13, Prathvi Raj Market. New Delhi-03 at the time of sampling and accused No. 2 Smt. Laxmi was the proprietor of the said firm and as such both the vendor and the proprietor are incharge of and responsible for day to day conduct of the business of the said shop. 5. It is further stated that the sampled food article manufactured and supplied by accused No. 3 M/s Kothari Product Ltd. 24/19, The Mall, Kanpur 208001, UP. (India). Accused No. 3 M/s Kothari Product Ltd. has appointed accused No. 4 Rajesh Shah as its nominee as per PFA Act and as such he is incharge of and responsible for day to day conduct of the business of the said company. Being a company M/s Kothari Product Ltd. is also liable. 6. Thereafter on completion of investigation, sanction under section 20 of the PFA Act was obtained from the Director PFA. The complaint was then filed in the court on 14.01.2005 alleging violation of Da vs Sukhdev Sharma Etc. on 2 May, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100338657/ 2 section 2(ia)(a)(m) of PFA Act, 1954 and Rule 62 of PFA Rule, 1955 as DA vs Sukhdev Sharma etc. punishable section 7/16(1)(a) of PFA Act against the accused. 7. As the complaint was filed in writing by a public servant, recording of pre-summoning evidence was dispensed with and the accused was summoned vide order dated 14.01.2005. The accused thereafter exercised their option of analysing the counter part through CFL under section 13 (2) of the PFA Act. Based on the report of the CFL notice was framed against the accused for commission of the offence punishable under section 7/16(1) (a) PFA Act being violation of Section 2(ia)(a)&(m) of PFA Act, 1954 and also Rule 62 of PFA Rules 1955, to which accused person pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. 8. At the trial, the prosecution examined two witness in support of its case i.e. PW-1 SDM/LHA Sh S.K. Hari and PW-2 FA Sh Pratap. PW-2 and FI Shri D.P. Singh were part of the team that had visited the spot for sample proceedings under the supervision of LHA Sh S.K. Hari. These witness narrated the steps undertaken by them during the sample proceedings, including disclosing their identity, expressing intention to purchase sample for analysis, lifting the nine sealed tins of Pan Masala (Pan Parag Brand) of 100 gms each bearing identical label declaration from the vendor for analysis, dividing the sample into three equal parts by putting three sealed tins together as one counterpart, separately sealing, packing and marking the same and obtaining signatures of vendor and witnesses. They also proved the necessary documents including the vendor's receipt Ex.PW-1/A, Notice in Form-VI Ex. PW-1/B, Panchnama Ex. PW-1/C. The Notice u/s 14-A Ex.PW1/D was prepared at the spot addressed to accused No. 3 M/s Kothari Products. Thereafter, one counterpart of the sample was deposited DA vs Sukhdev Sharma etc. with PA vide receipt Ex.PW1/E and the remaining two counter parts of the sample were deposited with LHA vide LHA Receipt Ex.PW1/F. Thereafter, PA Report Ex.PW1/G was received, according to which the sample was not conforming to the standards. Thereafter on the directions of SDM/LHA PW1 Sh S.K.Hari, FI Shri D.P. Singh conducted the investigation and during investigation he sent letter Ex.PW1/H to STO, Ward No. 98 and received its reply. FI Shri D.P. Singh also sent other letters to various parties and received reply, which are from Ex.PW1/H-1 to Ex.PW1/H-13. FI Shri D.P. Singh also sent letter Ex.PW1/I to CMO Kanpur and a copy Ex.PW1/I-1 of the same to Medical Secretary (Health), Lucknow. He also sent letter Ex.PW1/J to LHA, Kanpur and copy Ex.PW1/J-1 to Medical Secretary, Lucknow. He also sent letter Ex.PW1/J-2 to Registrar of Companies, Kanpur. A reply Ex.PW1/K of one advocate Shri S.N. Shukla on behalf of M/s Kothari Product was received. The reply Ex.PW1/K-1 from Chief Medical Officer, Kanpur was also received alongwith document Ex.PW1/K2 and K-3. After completion of investigation, the entire case file was put before then Director PFA for obtaining his Consent. The then Director PFA granted his Consent for prosecution vide sanction order Ex.PW1/L. Thereafter, the present complaint Ex. PW1/M was filed before this Hon'ble Court. Then intimation letters Ex.PW2/A were sent along with copy of PA Reports to the accused persons vide received report Ex.PW2/B. These witnesses were duly cross-examined by Ld. Defence Counsel. 9. Statement of the accused under section 313 CrPC were recorded on 10.02.2010 wherein the accused persons denied the allegations and pleaded innocence. Thereafter matter was listed for defence evidence. 10. In their defence, the accused persons examined Dr. O.P. Singhal, M.S.C Ph.D Retired Profession and head of Department of Dairy Chemistry, NDRI, Karnal as DW-1, Sh K.P. Singh Retired Analyst, DMS as DW-2, Sh H.N. Bhandari, Diary Chemist, DMS as DW-3, Sh Kanchit Singh, Analyst, DMS as DW-4, Sh Ishwar Singh, Lab Assistant, DMS as DW-5.
